name: NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet Platform
bandwidth_basis: PER LANE, PER DIRECTION. 800 Gb/s = 100 GB/s per direction per port.
topology: Leaf-spine Ethernet. Spectrum-X Multiplane scales to 128K GPUs in two tiers.
switching: Spectrum-X Ethernet switches (SN5000, SN6000) with Spectrum-X SuperNICs. RoCE acceleration, congestion management, crypto acceleration, programmable I/O. SONiC and Cumulus Linux NOS options.
notes: Spectrum-X is NVIDIA's purpose-built Ethernet platform for AI. Product page claims 1.6x network performance over off-the-shelf Ethernet and 95% efficiency at 100K+ GPU scale (vendor claims). Uses Spectrum-X SuperNICs (based on BlueField-3) for RoCE connectivity. Spectrum-XGS for cross-data-center connectivity with topology-aware congestion control. Multiplane enables flat two-tier topology up to 128K GPUs. Silicon photonics versions for power efficiency. The platform is the Ethernet alternative to InfiniBand for AI clusters.
